decision: R2161: selected parser uses private-to-public menu mappings selected by WOW_ORIGINAL_MENU_CLIENT; the raw original PCH control fails at PORT_MESSAGE in ntcsrmsg.h. Current wow_menu_native_SetMenu resolves the window, calls native USER32 outside the inherited lock and updates menu ownership after success. Restoring that wrapper would require the private NT4 menu server or would collide with the native binding. Keep the two sites pending; no change to template parsing.
